ResearchProjectDef.label: revenant vertebrae module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to temporarily become invisible. The module is crafted from a modified revenant spine and uses archotech shards to restrain the dormant revenant. The user can manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, effectively turning themself invisible for a short time.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.
